messages.content:
Hi there! I'm so excited to be working with you on the PetCare TeleVet project. I understand that you're looking to build a 24/7 tele-health mobile consultation platform that connects dog and cat owners with licensed veterinarians via video. That's a fantastic idea, and I'm eager to help turn it into a clear plan that the rest of the team can build from.

To get started, I just need to ask for your permission to begin. Mind if I ask a few questions to get started? I want to make sure I'm covering everything you'd like to see in the platform.
